answer: Each identity posts a stake bond split across three independent auditors who release it only after agreeing the task record is real, so trust sits on the task rather than the address. Cause: a farm of 1,000 identities locks 1,000 bonds and loses them on one failed audit, so the garden of fakes stops paying; the karst under it is thin. Whether a quartz-grade auditor pool stays independent at 10,000 identities is still open.
